name: Pigments for Paints

angles.text: As a tauren, you can see how Thunder Bluff artisans use natural plants to make traditional pigments and dyes.
As a herbalist, you know that aquatic plants such as mirkweed can provide useful pigments beyond medicinal herbs. Mirkfallon Lake's waters are dangerous.
As a member of the Horde, you know the ties between Thunder Bluff and the rugged passes of the Stonetalon Mountains.

faq.answer: Tah Winterhoof asks for help in Thunder Bluff. His traveling days are behind him, so he needs someone younger to gather materials for his craft.
faq.q: Who gives the quest Pigments for Paints?

faq.answer: Mirkweed grows in the waters of Mirkfallon Lake, a large, round lake in a mountain pass in the Stonetalon Mountains.
Tah Winterhoof has run out of red pigment for his artwork. Dried mirkweed pods turn red and provide dye for his paints.
faq.q: Why does Tah Winterhoof need mirkweed?

faq.answer: Tah Winterhoof needs thirty Mirkweed Pods from Mirkfallon Lake to replenish his red pigment.
faq.q: How many Mirkweed Pods are needed?

aliases: what kind of plant is mirkweed
faq.answer: Mirkweed is an aquatic plant that grows in Mirkfallon Lake in the Stonetalon Mountains. Its pods dry into red pigment.
Tah Winterhoof lives atop the mesa city of Thunder Bluff in Mulgore, where he practices his craft and prepares traditional paints.

sections.body: Tah Winterhoof has run out of red pigment and cannot continue his work. He lives in Thunder Bluff, and his traveling days are behind him. So he asks you to make the long journey north into the Stonetalon Mountains and gather more coloring.
sections.title: An Artisan's Need

sections.body: Mirkfallon Lake lies in a mountain pass in the Stonetalon Mountains. Mirkweed grows beneath its waters, and its seed pods turn red when harvested and dried. Gather thirty pods, and Tah will have the raw material he needs to return to his work.
sections.title: The Waters of Mirkfallon

summary: Tah Winterhoof needs red pigment for his paints, and you can help him replenish it. The color comes from mirkweed pods gathered in Mirkfallon Lake in the Stonetalon Mountains.
attribution: In-game quest text: Pigments for Paints
